prs.title: Add file-backed storage for gateway OAuth credentials
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add file-backed storage for gateway OAuth credentials

## What changed

Allow gateway OAuth configuration to select `credentials_store = "file"` to persist credentials in plaintext at `$CODEX_HOME/secrets/gateway_oauth.json`. Keep `keyring` as the default.

Read, update, and delete file-backed credentials by credential ID, using atomic writes and the existing cross-process lock. Preserve the serialized provider identity when using the default store.

## Testing

Add an app-server test that completes gateway OAuth login with file storage, verifies Unix file permissions are `0600`, and checks that login remains successful after a server restart.

prs.title: Preserve realtime V3 transcripts in conversation history
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve realtime V3 transcripts in conversation history

## Why

Long realtime conversations could lose speech when active transcripts and handoff transcript fields were truncated.

## What changed

- Record completed V3 transcript chunks in model and client history once the active transcript exceeds 4 KiB, without triggering inference.
- Keep unfinished utterances pending to preserve conversation order, and persist completed chunks before subsequent handoffs.
- Preserve full V3 transcript text at handoff and session-end tail flush, and avoid adding handoff input already recorded in transcript history.

## Testing

Add integration coverage for long transcripts, XML escaping, recording before handoff without inference, repeated handoff input, and both session-end tail flush settings.

prs.title: Preserve unrelated side conversations when archiving or deleting threads
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve unrelated side conversations when archiving or deleting threads

## Why

Archiving or deleting a thread in the command center shuts down side conversations belonging to other threads.

## What changed

Limit side conversation shutdown to those whose parents belong to the affected thread's known subtree. Proceed once those conversations close successfully, even if unrelated side conversations remain. Continue shutting down all side conversations on exit.

## Testing

Extend the delete lifecycle test to verify that an unrelated side conversation remains open after deletion.

prs.title: Enable the agent command center for embedded sessions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Enable the agent command center for embedded sessions

## Why

Command-center navigation required a shared app server, leaving embedded sessions without the same way to switch between chats. Archiving or deleting an embedded session also exited the TUI.

## What changed

- Enable command-center navigation and session listing for embedded sessions, including navigation from read-only conversations and the safety precaution menu.
- Return to the command center after archiving or deleting a session.
- Retain thread subscriptions when forking, including on embedded servers.
- Confirm before quitting an embedded server would stop running sessions or side conversations.
- Construct large startup and event-loop futures outside their callers' stack frames before boxing them.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for embedded session switching with background approvals and draft restoration, plus confirmation before quitting with a running side conversation. Update navigation, archive/delete, fork, and UI snapshot tests for the new behavior.

prs.title: Enable the agent command center in embedded mode
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Enable the agent command center in embedded mode

## Why

The agent command center previously required a shared background server, preventing embedded sessions from opening it and rejecting `codex agents --no-daemon`.

## What changed

- Allow `codex agents --no-daemon` to use an embedded app server and open the command center without a shared server.
- Route `codex agents` through the normal daemon startup, eligibility, and compatibility checks, including embedded fallback where applicable.
- Return embedded sessions to the command center when canceling directory trust or archived-session confirmation.

## Testing

Add CLI coverage for `--no-daemon` before and after `agents`, plus an integration test that verifies embedded mode is used even when a daemon is running. Update archived-session tests to expect cancellation to return to the command center.

prs.title: Enable TUI task tools for embedded app-server sessions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Enable TUI task tools for embedded app-server sessions

## Why

Embedded app-server sessions disabled task tools and exposed only worktree tools through MCP, preventing tasks from using tools such as `set_thread_title`.

## What changed

- Expose task tools and available worktree tools together under the `codex_tui` MCP namespace, replacing the embedded session's `codex_worktrees` namespace.
- Allow embedded sessions to dispatch `codex_tui` dynamic tools when MCP is not configured, while retaining the MCP requirement for delegation tools.
- Persist local task-tool reference capabilities for embedded sessions as well.

## Testing

Update coverage for embedded dynamic-tool namespace dispatch and task-tool availability after starting and resuming threads. Extend the model-driven worktree test to rename another task through `set_thread_title` and snapshot the combined MCP tool set.

prs.title: Update `mio` from 1.2.0 to 1.2.4
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body: Update `mio` from 1.2.0 to 1.2.4

prs.title: Reload remote executor credentials safely across token rotation
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reload remote executor credentials safely across token rotation

## Why

ChatGPT credentials can rotate while a remote executor is idle. Registry requests need to follow stored rotations without continuing after logout or switching the executor's identity. Concurrent refreshes must also avoid overwriting newer credentials.

## What changed

- Reload and validate ChatGPT credentials before registry requests, pinning the credential mode, account, user, and workspace policy. Reuse cached metadata for unchanged personal access tokens.
- Retry registration when temporary credential resolution failures prevent a request from being sent. Bound credential resolution and block reuse of a token generation whose refresh outcome is unknown.
- Restrict supported authentication modes before executor startup loads credentials or cloud configuration.
- Serialize persistent credential writes across cooperating processes and compare stored credentials before committing refreshed tokens.
- Replace `auth.json` atomically so overlapping readers see a complete document, preserving symlink targets and protecting file permissions, including Windows access controls.

## Testing

Add coverage for credential rotation, logout, identity changes, cancelled refresh callers, temporary metadata failures, registration retries, concurrent credential writes, and atomic file replacement.

prs.title: Reuse `LocalImageAttachment` throughout the TUI composer
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reuse `LocalImageAttachment` throughout the TUI composer

## What changed

Replace the duplicate `AttachedImage` type with `LocalImageAttachment`. Return borrowed attachment slices and move attachment vectors directly when taking submissions or capturing history-search drafts, avoiding conversion and cloning. Use `local_image_paths()` in request-user-input and MCP elicitation drafts to copy only the paths they need.

prs.title: Add local image thumbnails to the TUI composer
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add local image thumbnails to the TUI composer

## What changed

- Show draft attachment thumbnails in reference order in inline and fullscreen views on supported terminals with local workspaces. Display a `+N` count for attachments that do not fit, and preserve editable image references when previews are unavailable or space is limited.
- Refresh previews when attached files change, apply image orientation metadata, and clear frame graphics before terminal handoffs, screen switches, and shutdown.
- Finish CLI subcommand dispatch before polling interactive TUI events.

## Testing

Add a regression test and snapshot covering thumbnail order, overflow, resizing, attachment deletion, file replacement, and fallback behavior in both inline and fullscreen views.

prs.title: Show unread results in the TUI command center
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Show unread results in the TUI command center

## What changed

- Display blue filled dots for unread results and gray hollow dots for read idle tasks, preserving status text on narrow rows.
- Load unread state with thread listings and update markers from read-state notifications and refreshes.
- Acknowledge the observed receipt revision when a conversation is rendered in a focused, unobstructed view, including read-only snapshots, without clearing newer results.

## Testing

Extend rendering snapshots and tests for stale unread markers and read-only snapshot receipts.

prs.title: Show unread sessions and acknowledge viewed transcripts in the picker
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Show unread sessions and acknowledge viewed transcripts in the picker

## What changed

- Show a blue unread dot in both session picker layouts using backend read states.
- Acknowledge the transcript's observed revision after rendering it in a focused terminal, then update the unread indicator from the response.
- Key cached transcripts by backend and thread, reload them when unread revisions differ, and ignore canceled transcript results.
- Include turn errors in transcripts.

## Testing

Extend picker tests to cover unread indicators, selection colors, acknowledgments after rendering, and turn error display.

prs.title: Preserve transcript history when clearing the terminal with Ctrl+L
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve transcript history when clearing the terminal with Ctrl+L

## Why

`Ctrl+L` discarded the retained transcript along with the terminal display, making earlier exchanges unavailable in the detailed transcript.

## What changed

Keep earlier exchanges accessible through `Ctrl+T` while starting a fresh terminal display with a new header. Treat that header as the boundary for compact scrolling, pinned prompts, and resize replay so cleared content stays hidden in the normal view. Allow the detailed transcript to load older history after clearing.

## Testing

Extend the `Ctrl+L` regression test and add a detailed-transcript snapshot covering retained exchanges, draft preservation, older-history loading, and cleared-content visibility after resizing and replay.

prs.title: Recognize Rex terminals and enable Kitty graphics for pets
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Recognize Rex terminals and enable Kitty graphics for pets

## What changed

- Detect Rex from `TERM_PROGRAM=rex` or `TERM=xterm-rex` and report its name in terminal diagnostics.
- Enable Kitty graphics for pets in Rex.
- Use the detected terminal identity for Rex's label-only web links, extending that behavior to detection through `TERM`.

## Testing

Add Rex detection coverage for both environment variables and include Rex in the web-link rendering and Kitty graphics support tests.

prs.title: Reuse connected backends in the in-app resume picker
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reuse connected backends in the in-app resume picker

## What changed

- List sessions from listening backends and the displayed session's backend using their existing connections.
- Give picker views distinct request ID namespaces while keeping connection ownership and event handling with the live sessions.
- Start multi-backend listings without a working-directory filter, since local and remote workspaces cannot share a single path filter.

## Testing

Add coverage for distinct picker request IDs, preserving the live event stream after picker shutdown, listing all providers after a provider switch while retaining the remote working-directory filter, and clearing the pending cursor when a source fails late.

prs.title: Allow inline patch review during approval prompts
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Allow inline patch review during approval prompts

## Why

Collapsed patch details should remain accessible while an approval prompt is open, and reviewing them should not leave the transcript stuck behind new output after approval.

## What changed

Allow clicking transcript disclosure controls while a modal prompt is open. When expanding details during patch approval interrupts following the latest output, resume following once that approval ends or advances to another patch. Preserve manual scrolling and text selection instead of automatically jumping to the latest output.

## Testing

Extend patch approval coverage with an inline expansion snapshot and checks for queued approvals and subsequent output. Add a regression test that preserves manual scroll position when approval ends.

prs.title: Treat auth reload failures as transient during token refresh
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Treat auth reload failures as transient during token refresh

## Why

An unreadable or malformed `auth.json` could be treated as an account mismatch during token refresh or unauthorized recovery, producing a permanent failure.

## What changed

Propagate storage errors from guarded auth reloads as transient failures, preserving cached credentials and allowing recovery to retry. Apply credential-safe error formatting to file deserialization and agent identity JWT decoding.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for empty files, invalid auth fields, and invalid JWT claims. Verify that failures preserve cached tokens, auth change state, and network permits without exposing credential values in errors, and that unauthorized recovery can resume after the file is restored.

prs.title: Add an MCP adapter for message-board tools
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add an MCP adapter for message-board tools

## What changed

Add `codex-message-board-mcp` with a `MessageBoardMcpServer` that exposes selected message-board tools through `rmcp::ServerHandler`. Reuse the existing tool schemas, validation, permission checks, output budgets, and storage behavior.

Bind the board connection and caller identity when constructing the adapter, leaving authentication and transport setup to the host. Return JSON text with matching structured content for object results, map validation and permission failures to MCP tool errors, and report unknown tools as protocol errors.

Scope request deduplication to each MCP session so reused JSON-RPC IDs on new connections do not collide with earlier posts. Preserve the distinction between numeric and string request IDs.

## Testing

Add integration tests for tool discovery, bounded results, caller identity validation, unknown tools, request deduplication within and across sessions, and read-only permission denials. Exercise discovery and calls against both local and in-memory boards.

prs.title: Preserve fallback token refreshes when the keyring is unreadable
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve fallback token refreshes when the keyring is unreadable

## Why

Automatic credential storage can load fallback credentials when the keyring is unreadable, but refreshing those credentials previously failed to save the rotated tokens. Unresolvable `auth.json` symlinks could also block keyring credential updates and logout.

## What changed

- Save refreshed fallback credentials to the file store when the keyring cannot be read, while still rejecting stale credentials and refreshes after logout. Leave the unread keyring entry untouched, even if it recovers before the save.
- Allow keyring commits to proceed when fallback symlink resolution fails. Continue sharing the resolved target's commit lock for valid symlink chains so logout coordinates with concurrent refreshes.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for persistent keyring read failures, stale fallback refreshes, logout, unusable fallback symlinks, and cross-process locking through chained symlinks.

prs.title: Resolve network approval prompts when their requests end
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Resolve network approval prompts when their requests end

## Why

A network request can disappear while its approval prompt is still pending. Leaving that prompt active allows a late cancellation to interrupt the turn even though the request no longer needs approval.

## What changed

- Track network prompt lifetimes in core and notify the app server when a prompt is resolved or withdrawn.
- Cancel the corresponding server request, emit `serverRequest/resolved`, and release its permission guard. Resolve outstanding network prompts during thread shutdown as well.
- Claim a live pending approval and validate its originating turn before applying a decision, so stale responses cannot interrupt a turn or persist policy changes.
- Distinguish network approvals that require the originating turn from proxy approvals that can be serviced by a later active turn.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for disconnected network requests, late cancellation responses, turn completion during review, shutdown cleanup, mismatched turn IDs, and command approvals from background code running during a later turn.

prs.title: Serialize manual network approval prompts per endpoint
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Serialize manual network approval prompts per endpoint

## Why

Concurrent executions accessing the same endpoint can produce duplicate network approval prompts before a session decision is recorded.

## What changed

- Queue manual prompts by environment, host, protocol, and port while keeping execution decisions separate.
- After a one-time approval or denial, let the next execution prompt. Reuse committed session grants and deny rules without another prompt.
- Keep tool results paused while requests are queued and attribute the wait to the triggering tool call.

## Testing

Extend coverage for concurrent requests, one-time and session decisions, independent ports, queued cancellation and timing, and isolation between local and remote environments.

prs.title: Allow Apps catalog discovery before the initial tool inventory completes
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Allow Apps catalog discovery before the initial tool inventory completes

## Why

Plugin and skill catalog reads currently wait for the Apps server's initial `tools/list` to finish, even after its MCP transport is initialized.

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `features.apps_early_resource_discovery` flag. When enabled, host-owned Apps requests for `mcp/plugin` and `mcp/skill` resources can use the initialized transport while the initial tool inventory is pending. Server readiness still waits for the inventory to complete, and retries use normal readiness.

Bound early client acquisition by the configured startup timeout, propagate startup failures and cancellation, and reject pages if the connection, authentication scope, or resource cache generation changes during discovery.

## Testing

Add coverage for gated discovery, concurrent plugin and skill reads, startup timeouts and failures, cancellation, cache invalidation, and account switches. Verify that early discovery reuses a single handshake and tool inventory, including with the newer MCP protocol and connection sharing enabled.

prs.title: Fix remote executor authentication timeout recovery
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix remote executor authentication timeout recovery

## Why

Registration can time out while resolving credentials, before any request is sent. Treating this as a transport timeout prevents a safe retry. Credential resolution timeouts can also incorrectly quarantine credentials when no OAuth refresh exchange has started.

## What changed

- Classify registration deadlines reached before the first send as `RequestNotSent`, allowing the existing registration retry loop to recover. Preserve transport timeout handling once a request has been sent.
- Track unsettled ChatGPT refreshes in `AuthManager` from the start of the OAuth exchange through credential persistence. Cancellation while waiting for the refresh guard or reading credentials does not mark them as unsettled.
- Have the executor auth provider withhold credentials with an unsettled refresh. Preserve uncertainty after a cancelled exchange even if a later refresh fails, while allowing replacement credentials and successfully completed refreshes.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for registration and connection deadlines across auth stages, retrying registration after an unsent credential timeout, recovery after slow replacement PAT metadata, and cancellation before and during OAuth refresh.

prs.title: Extract pre-tool-use hook handling into a helper
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Extract pre-tool-use hook handling into a helper

## What changed

Move hook execution and input updates into `apply_pre_tool_use`, with distinct errors for blocked calls, failures, and cancellation. Preserve dispatch error reporting and clear the serving assessment when a hook changes the invocation payload.

prs.title: Preserve model metadata origin through runtime resolution
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve model metadata origin through runtime resolution

## What changed

Return `CatalogModel` from model lookups, keeping metadata together with its `Bundled`, `Provider`, `ExplicitConfig`, or `Synthetic` origin through config overrides and runtime snapshots. Replace `used_fallback_model_metadata` checks with explicit `Synthetic` origin checks.

Share the underlying `Arc<ModelInfo>` with extension stores and use copy-on-write for metadata changes. Keep origin tracking outside serialized model metadata.

## Testing

Extend coverage for origin retention across cache reloads, namespaced model lookups, catalog fallback, and config overrides. Verify that step snapshots and extension stores share the same model metadata allocation.

prs.title: Apply PreToolUse hooks before direct Guardian review policy checks
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Apply PreToolUse hooks before direct Guardian review policy checks

## Why

Direct Guardian review checked recorded `exec_command` calls without applying `PreToolUse` hooks, so approval decisions could miss hook rewrites or denials.

## What changed

Run the shared `PreToolUse` hook handling before evaluating approval requirements. Use the rewritten arguments for policy checks and the Guardian approval request, and return an error when a hook blocks the call, even if policy would otherwise skip review.

## Testing

Add regression tests covering rewritten commands that require approval and hook denials for policy-allowed commands. Verify the rewritten approval request, hook events and recorded denial context, and that reviewed commands are not executed.

prs.title: Scope agent MCP metadata to a host-selected plugin registration
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Scope agent MCP metadata to a host-selected plugin registration

## What changed

Add `AgentMcpMetadataRecipient` as a thread extension that lets the host select which MCP plugin registration receives `x-codex-root-turn-id` and `x-codex-cyber-access-program` in tool-call metadata.

Require an exact match on the plugin ID, installed root, server name, and transport configuration in the `local` MCP environment. Omit both keys without host opt-in or when the registration does not match, including same-name user overrides. Send JSON null for unset values on matching registrations.

## Testing

Add unit tests for registration matching and integration coverage for host opt-in, same-name user overrides, and an unset access program.

prs.title: Broadcast thread section changes to connected clients
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Broadcast thread section changes to connected clients

## Why

Clients need to refresh section membership and ordering when another client moves a thread.

## What changed

Broadcast `thread/section/changed` after a successful `thread/section/move`, including moves within the same section. Send the response before the notification, and include `threadId` and the destination `sectionId`, using `null` for removal. Failed moves do not emit the notification.

Add the notification to the protocol schemas, TypeScript exports, and Python SDK models and registry, and document its behavior.

## Testing

Add a WebSocket integration test with separate writer and observer clients covering section insertion, reordering, removal, and a failed move.

prs.title: Fix unsettled refresh detection after workspace switching
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix unsettled refresh detection after workspace switching

## Why

Workspace switching rewrites claims returned by `get_token_data()`, so comparing those tokens with the stored refresh generation can fail to recognize an unfinished ChatGPT refresh.

## What changed

Compare tokens from the current auth JSON with the unsettled refresh generation, preserving detection when workspace claims differ from the original ID token.

## Testing

Extend the refresh cancellation regression test to cover a workspace switch that retains the original ID and refresh tokens.

Fix context token estimates for responses without usable usage
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix context token estimates for responses without usable usage

## Why

Retained output from failed responses or responses without usage data can be omitted from context token estimates, delaying automatic compaction even as reasoning accumulates.

## What changed

Track the history boundary covered by the last usable usage report and estimate all items added after it. Spending-only updates preserve that boundary, while successful usage reports cover the request input even when the response contains no output items. Avoid counting unreported reasoning twice and align recomputed context counts and remote compaction estimates with the boundary.

## Testing

Add unit coverage for initial input, empty responses, spending-only updates, and reasoning accounting. Add regression coverage verifying that accumulated unreported reasoning triggers compaction for incomplete responses with or without usage and completed responses without usage.
